0022600119.text: Charlotte hosts Washington in the Hornets' fourth game of the season, with both teams at 2-1 on a W1 streak; the Hornets are 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, while the Wizards are 6th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast. The teams have not played each other yet this season, but the Hornets won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently a 129-112 win in Washington on February 22, 2026. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), and Naz Reid is day-to-day with an illness, a game-time decision, while Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve).
